benefits.name: Glide
benefits.description: If jumping from a height elevated by at least 30 feet (9 m) from your surroundings, you can glide a long distance before landing at some lower point in range.

benefits.name: Reduced Falling Damage
benefits.description: You reduce your falling damage from a fall by one wound severity.

benefits.name: No GM Intrusion on Dodge
benefits.description: You don't get a GM intrusion if you roll a 1 on a dodge roll.

system.description: Aaraks like you hail from a canyon-carved volcanic world that enjoys an embarrassment of thermals, updrafts from when the wind streams over mountains and ridges, and "cloud streets" of aligned lanes of cumulus clouds running parallel to the wind. Feathered, light-boned, and described as "avian" by certain other species, you've left your homeworld, looking for adventures (and thermals!) on other planets and habitats.
